offer.text: I forged a fine blade but I'm no swordsman. Put down 8 zombies with it and tell me how it cuts.

accept.text: Aim true and report back. For science, as it were.

decline.text: Untested steel is just a heavy bar.

in_progress.text: How does the blade handle the dead?

ready.text: Eight down? Then the temper holds. Excellent data.

complete.text: You've proven my craft. Take this, with my gratitude.
